title: L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

reports.title: Messerangriff auf Kinder: Täter «kaufte Rindfleisch, um zu üben»
Chinese hatte Tat zusammen mit ChatGPT geplant!
Zürich-Oerlikon: Angriff auf Kinder eines Kinderhortes mit Verletzungsfolgen
L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

summary:
On 1 October 2024, a 23-year-old Chinese student attacked three five-year-old boys outside a childcare centre in Zurich Oerlikon with a knife whose blade was about 8.5 centimetres long. One boy had a major vein at his collarbone completely severed and needed emergency surgery, another was stabbed twice in the chest and nearly died from heart and blood vessel injuries, and the third suffered wounds to his ear and lung. A childcare worker grabbed the attacker's arms, he dropped the knife and surrendered, and passersby held him until police arrived.

Prosecutors say the man, who had come to Switzerland a year earlier for a master's degree, planned the attack for weeks. He used ChatGPT to ask about legal consequences of stabbing random victims, ordered clothes and kitchen knives, studied anatomy, and bought raw beef to practise stabbing. He chose 1 October, China's national day, and posted patriotic content online shortly before the attack. At his trial on Thursday, the prosecution is seeking a 15-year prison sentence and a 15-year expulsion from Switzerland.
title_en: The man who attacked a Swiss daycare found his victims on ChatGPT
